name: Hag’s Touch, Greater
body:
School necromancy [curse]; Level antipaladin 4, spiritualist 5, sorcerer/wizard 5, witch 5
Duration permanent

DESCRIPTION

As hag’s touch, except as above. Long-term victims continue to age normally, potentially gaining some benefits of aging.
